title: Part One, Chapter 1: The Creation of the World

verses.t: This is the account of how it was, when all was suspended in calm, in silence, without motion, with nothing but the empty sky.

And this is the first word and the first speech. There were not yet men, animals, birds, fish, crabs, trees, stones, hollows, ravines, grass or forests; there was only the sky. The face of the earth had not appeared; there was only the sea, held back, and all that belongs to the sky. Nothing was yet joined together, nothing made a sound, nothing stirred, nothing did harm, nothing made "cotzu" (that is, a noise in the sky), and nothing stood upright; there was only the still water, only the calm sea, only it, held back; nothing at all existed. There was only silence and quiet in the darkness and the night. There was only the Creator and Former, the Lord, the strong serpent; the mothers and fathers were in the water, in an open brightness, and they were covered with green feathers, and that is why he is called Cucumatz. They were great sages and of great understanding, and so the sky exists, and there is also the Heart of the Sky, which is the name by which that god is called. And then his word came here; it came with the lords Tepeu and Cucumatz, here in the darkness and in the night, and it spoke with Tepeu and Cucumatz. And they say that they consulted and pondered, that they came together and held council, that they spoke their minds and thought together, and then the creatures appeared; they planned the making and creation of the trees and vines, and the making of life and creation, in the darkness and the gloom, by the Heart of the Sky, who is called Huracán (that is, "of one leg," a proper name). The first is called Caculha-huracan (a proper name meaning "lightning of one leg"), the second Chipa-caculha (a proper name meaning "the small sea of the lightnings"), and the third Raxa-caculha (a proper name meaning "green lightning"), so that the Heart of the Sky who came with Tepeu and Cucumatz is three. Then life and creation were discussed: "How shall it be sown, and how shall it dawn? Who shall be made to provide and sustain? Give your counsel. Let this water go out and be cleared away, so that the earth may come forth and be joined together; and so let the sky and the earth be sown and made bright, and so there will be nothing in the way of the creatures, our works, when men are created, the creatures and the formed ones." And they say that the earth was formed by them; by their word alone the earth was made and came to be. "Earth!" they said, and at once it was made, like a mist and like a cloud; it took shape in pieces, laid like a crab upon the water. The mountains were made by miracle and wonder alone; and in an instant the cypresses and pines sprang up on their face, and Cucumatz rejoiced. "Your coming is good, Heart of the Sky, you, Huracán, and you, Chipa-caculha and Raxa-caculha; our work and our creatures shall be completed," they said. First the earth was created, the mountains and the plains; the paths of the water were divided, and many streams ran among the hills, and in certain places the water stopped and stood still, and then the great mountains appeared. So the earth was formed, created by those who are called the Heart of the Sky and the Heart of the Earth; and this is the first thing they conceived, while the sky and the earth were still within the water. And so what they conceived and thought out was completed and made by them.
